$comment: Generated by tools/space-shape.mjs: the space roles in the compact option, for [data-space='compact']. Never edit by hand.

stack-pair.$description: Stacked pair that reads as one: label and field, title and subtitle (compact space)

stack-row.$description: Between rows of a list whose rows carry their own fill (navigation items, menu items), so two fills never touch (compact space)

stack-item.$description: Stacked items in one group (compact space)

stack-group.$description: Groups within a section; fields in a form (compact space)

stack-section.$description: Sections of a view; a section's head to its content (compact space)

stack-page.$description: Between the top-level parts of a page: a site's bands, a library page's sections (twice the section level) (compact space)

inline-pair.$description: Side-by-side pair: icon and label (compact space)

inline-item.$description: Items in one row: buttons in a group (compact space)

inline-group.$description: Groups in a row: toolbar groups (compact space)

inset-xs.$description: Inside a compact group, around each member’s fill: a segmented control (compact space)

inset-sm.$description: Inside compact containers: menus, list rows (compact space)

inset-md.$description: Inside cards, popovers and panels (compact space)

inset-lg.$description: Inside dialogs, sheets and page regions (compact space)

gutter.$description: Between columns and regions of a layout (compact space)

margin-page.$description: Content to window edge on small screens (compact space)
